snippet.title: I made a CGI point & click adventure for DOS
snippet.description:
Monster Mansion 3D (2025) is a point and click game that runs on MS-DOS 

if you'd like to see my art without YouTube Garbage Compression™️ you can play it here:
https://yopachi.itch.io/monster-mansion-3d

Developed with:
💾Adventure Game Studio
💿Martin Hash's Animation:Master
💿Photoshop
💾RAD Video Tools 

#indiegame #retrogaming #pointandclick #weirdcore #y2k
